citation.title: Overview (NACE section)
citation.venue_or_publisher: ec.europa.eu (Eurostat web pages, per the URL)

definitions.definition: The classification of economic activities in the European Union; abbreviation of 'statistical classification of economic activities' in the European Community.
definitions.quote: is the classification of economic activities in the European Union (EU)
definitions.page: NACE section > Overview REVAMP EN, paragraph 1

limitations.point: The extracted text is a short landing page (about 306 words). It names the classification, its versions and links to other documents. It does not say how an organisation is assigned to a category, and it has no category list, codes or worked examples.
The page says which version applies to which period, but the guidance on how activities are classified is in linked documents that were not read.
limitations.quote: describe the overall logic of how activities are classified in NACE Rev. 2.1

limitations.point: No author, publication date or modified date is given for the page. The only date in the text, 17 September 2026, belongs to a linked publication entry.
limitations.page: NACE section > Overview link publication REVAMP EN, paragraph 13
